authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8209 pibati gives the widespread pi-/piy- “drink” verb. Ordinary piyo/piye inflections fit; pī-lo can include the take light verb, and pī-ryo a progressive construction, so these need full-predicate analysis. Reviewed comparator: H piyo “drink!” (f_xpcv75shnq3ye). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
